decisions.reason: As a very new and somewhat specialised sewer-infrastructure item, it may be under review, but its fit with municipal metal products and the lack of clear failure signals make continued testing more likely than withdrawal.
Public waste bins are a competitive but adjacent product for a metal fabricator, and the firm would likely keep it on the market while it learns whether results reach aspiration levels.
Ground sleeves for posts are a simple, capability-consistent fabricated product with broad use and low carrying cost, so there is little reason to drop them after only one year.
Cast iron ground sleeves look like a close variant within the same product family, so the firm would usually retain them unless early results were clearly below aspiration.
Steel ground sleeves fit the firm's core metalworking strengths and can likely be offered with minimal extra slack, which supports keeping them on the market.
